title: Tenzing Hillary Everest Marathon — official homepage (event overview and next date)
publisher: Tenzing Hillary Everest Marathon (event organiser, Kathmandu)
claims: The Everest Marathon is an annual international high-altitude adventure sports event held on 29 May from Mount Everest Base Camp, commemorating the 29 May 1953 Everest ascent by Tenzing Norgay Sherpa and Sir Edmund Hillary.

The event lists three distances: Half Marathon 21 km (Dingboche to Namche Bazar), Full Marathon 42.195 km (Everest Base Camp to Namche Bazar via Gorakshep, Dingboche, the Bibre loop and a scenic Kala Patthar climb), and UTME 70 km Ultra-Marathon (Everest Base Camp to Namche Bazaar).
The homepage countdown displays the next event date as 2027-05-29.
Non-runners trek the historical route to Kala Patthar to view Everest and witness the finish at Namche.
